BEGINNING
Be*gin"ning, n.

1. The first act or state of a succession of acts.
2. That which begins or originates something; the first cause.
Syn.
 -- Inception; origin.
BEGINNING
Be*gin"ning, n.

Defn: Enterprise. [Obs.]
EARTH SHINE
Earth" shine`.

Defn: See Earth light, under Earth.
A-
A-, prefix.

Defn: A prefix used in obsolete forms.
ABOVE-MENTIONED; ABOVE-NAMED
Above-mentioned; Above-named, a.

Defn: Named earlier.
